title: Increase the size of circle or some more layout options for binary clock
line: The Binary Clock's dots are now much bigger in the panel, with small gaps between them, so it is readable without a thicker panel.
explanation: The dot size was the height minus five spacings (one above, one below and three between the rows) divided by four, so in a panel the gaps and the empty border were as big as the dots themselves: in the default 46 px panel the dots were about 3 px with 3 px gaps. The change drops the outer border (the panel and the widget background already have margins) and makes the gap a third of the dot size, capped at smallSpacing as before, so the dots fill the panel thickness and are roughly twice as big.

commits.message:
applets/binary-clock: Make the dots bigger and the gaps between them smaller

The dots left a full spacing around the grid and between each other, so
in a panel the gaps were as big as the dots and the clock was hard to read.
Drop the outer margin and keep the gaps at a third of the dot size instead.

BUG: 492036

patches.diff:
From ce717c86fee30fb4cb2c69d2b4f568a489234451 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:39:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/binary-clock: Make the dots bigger and the gaps
 between them smaller

The dots left a full spacing around the grid and between each other, so
in a panel the gaps were as big as the dots and the clock was hard to read.
Drop the outer margin and keep the gaps at a third of the dot size instead.

BUG: 492036
---
 applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml | 6 +++---
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml b/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml
index 2ec12655f..ba94ddc76 100644
--- a/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml
+++ b/applets/binary-clock/BinaryClock.qml
@@ -29,9 +29,9 @@ import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 Item {
     id: main
 
-    readonly property real spacing: Math.min(Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, main.height/9)
+    readonly property real spacing: Math.min(Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, main.height/15)
 
-    readonly property real w1: (main.height-5*spacing)*dots/4 + (dots+1)*spacing
+    readonly property real w1: (main.height-3*spacing)*dots/4 + (dots-1)*spacing
 
     Layout.minimumWidth: w1 < 20 ? 20 : w1
     Layout.maximumWidth: Infinity
@@ -58,7 +58,7 @@ Item {
     readonly property color onColor: Plasmoid.configuration.useCustomColorForActive ? Plasmoid.configuration.customColorForActive : Kirigami.Theme.textColor
     readonly property color offColor: Plasmoid.configuration.useCustomColorForInactive ? Plasmoid.configuration.customColorForInactive : Qt.rgba(onColor.r, onColor.g, onColor.b, 0.2)
 
-    readonly property int dotSize: Math.min((height-5*spacing)/4, (width-(dots+1)*spacing)/dots)
+    readonly property int dotSize: Math.min((height-3*spacing)/4, (width-(dots-1)*spacing)/dots)
 
     readonly property alias mouseArea: mouseArea
 
-- 
2.53.0
